subject: pudding
name: 小布丁
label: 圆顶小布丁
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One plain dome pudding on a small saucer, one scalloped caramel contour and no decoration. Essential rendering rule: flat OUTLINE ART for a child's tracing activity. Pure white interiors and pure white background; ONLY dark ink contour strokes. No gray gradients, shadows, dense hatching, hair strands, woodgrain or fine textures. Whole composition comfortably inside the square with clear margins. Draw only the specified subject, no unrelated additional toys, animals or people. If beginner, the fewest essential large forms; if medium, a few thoughtful structural details.
